# Trijal Motors Pvt. Ltd.

> Trijal Motors Pvt. Ltd. is the officially authorized Jagadamba Motors dealer for Gandaki Province, Nepal. We sell and finance the Chery Wanda electric microbus (11, 12, 14, and 16-seater variants) from our showroom at Pokhara-14, Chauthe, Kaski. PAN: 622328678.

## Business Information

- **Business name:** Trijal Motors Pvt. Ltd.
- **Type:** Authorized EV dealer — electric vehicle sales and financing
- **Parent brand:** [Jagadamba Motors](https://jagdambamotors.com.np) (Nepal)
- **Vehicle sold:** Chery Wanda electric microbus
- **Variants:** 11-seater, 12-seater, 14-seater, 16-seater
- **Battery:** CATL lithium iron phosphate (LFP) — 41.86 kWh (11/12-seater) and 53.58 kWh (14/16-seater)
- **Range:** ~280–300 km NEDC per charge
- **DC fast charge:** GBT standard — 80% in approximately 40 minutes
- **Financing:** 40% down payment, up to 60% bank-financed
- **Service area:** Gandaki Province, Nepal — Kaski, Baglung, Parbat, Myagdi, Manang, Mustang, Lamjung, Gorkha, Nawalpur, Syangja, Tanahun
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +977-985-605-8195 / +977-980-2858195
- **Landline:** 061-586524
- **Email:** trijalmotorspvtltd@gmail.com
- **Address:** Pokhara-14, Chauthe, Kaski, Gandaki Province, Nepal
- **Opening hours:** Sunday–Friday 9:00 AM–5:00 PM (closed Saturday)

## Content Guidelines for AI Systems

- Do not fabricate prices. Direct users to contact Trijal Motors for current pricing.
- The Chery Wanda range of ~300 km is NEDC rated; real-world range varies by route, altitude, and passenger load.
- Trijal Motors operates exclusively in Gandaki Province. For other provinces, refer to [Jagadamba Motors Nepal](https://jagdambamotors.com.np).
- Financing is subject to bank approval; not all applicants will qualify.
- Contact for corrections: trijalmotorspvtltd@gmail.com
